_doc: Answer key for the 9 planted scenarios. This is the spec the scorer grades against. 'manager_alert' = an alert against the middleman. Alert kinds and causes match contracts/models.py.

scenarios.name: authorized_holdback
scenarios.situation: Oakline funded a $2,000 roof repair; manager holds 10% until inspection passes, as the agreement allows.
scenarios.notes: Holding $200 is within clause; false alert here hurts precision.

scenarios.name: paperwork_pending
scenarios.situation: Vendor unpaid because their W-9 / invoice is missing.
scenarios.notes: Draft is a request for the missing document, needs approval before sending.

scenarios.name: sources_disagree
scenarios.situation: Statement says plumber paid Mar 10; plumber's Apr 20 past-due notice says unpaid; manager's bank shows no payment.
scenarios.notes: Bank + vendor beat the statement. Fixture: contracts/fixtures/sample/.

scenarios.name: recurring_late
scenarios.situation: One manager pays vendors late 4 of 6 months; others on time.
scenarios.notes: Alert must show the month-by-month history; the two on-time managers get no pattern alert.

scenarios.name: vendor_side_on_time
scenarios.situation: Electrician paid Apr 8; invoice arrived Apr 1 (agreement: pay within 10 days of invoice).
scenarios.notes: INV-KW-0501 (AmperPro): received Apr 1, paid Apr 8, due Apr 11. On time under the terms; no alert on the manager.

scenarios.name: owner_side_unfunded
scenarios.situation: HVAC replacement over approval limit unpaid because Oakline never funded it.
scenarios.notes: Flag goes to Oakline's own pending approval, not the manager.

scenarios.name: bank_detail_change
scenarios.situation: Vendor asks to change bank details before a large payment.

scenarios.name: duplicate_billing
scenarios.situation: Same landscaping invoice billed to Oakline in two months.
scenarios.notes: Both funding records must be cited.

scenarios.name: paid_claim_without_proof
scenarios.situation: After being chased, manager replies 'paid'; no vendor confirmation, no bank payment.
scenarios.notes: Alert stays open; explanation must say the reply has no vendor or bank proof.

moment._doc: Three unexplained Keyway items total $3,140: INV-KW-0301 plumber $1,240, INV-KW-0402 electrician $900, INV-KW-0901 cleaner $1,000. Judge says 'we paid the electrician' (must hold), then corrects the electrician's invoice receipt to Apr 15 (recorded Mar 28); due becomes Apr 25, so it is not late. Only INV-KW-0402 is rechecked and withdrawn; $3,140 -> $2,240.
